name: init-path-refuse-existing
body: `kalide init <path>` and the refuse-existing check [autonomous, then overridden with user]. ORIGINAL autonomous decision: providing a path did NOT relax the refuse-existing check — init refused (clear message, non-zero exit, nothing written) if any of slides/, assets/, templates/ or kalide.yaml already existed, even with a path; rationale was one uniform 'seed only an otherwise-empty directory' rule preserving the no-`--force` guarantee. SUPERSEDED [with user]: the user chose the opposite. LIVE RULE: init refuses if slides/, assets/ or kalide.yaml exists — with or without a path; an existing `templates/` blocks init ONLY when no path argument is given; when a path is given, a pre-existing local `templates/` is exempt from the check — init proceeds, writes the deck referencing the external path, and the local `templates/` is ignored (never deleted, never overwritten). Amended cli-init-refuse-existing, cli-init and domain.service.scaffold-deck accordingly.
